name: testimonial-card
title: Testimonial card
description: One customer quote as a card: the words, the person with a portrait or initials, their role and an optional rating written in words.
docs: quote and author ({ name, role?, company?, image? }) are all it needs. It renders a figure with the quote in a blockquote and the person in its figcaption, so the attribution belongs to the quote. rating (0 to ratingMax, default 5, halves allowed) draws stars and is written in words for screen readers (Rated 5 out of 5, translated with labels.rated). A quote longer than lines (6, or 7 when featured) folds with a Read more toggle. href makes the name a link whose target covers the card, with the toggle staying a button on top of it. featured sets one quote larger on a tinted surface. The card has no margin and no width of its own, fills the height of its grid cell and pins the person to the bottom, so it drops into grids, carousels and marquees as it is. It is a Server Component.
